existing_weak_contract.meaning: Post-sampler RAW96 two-observer local visible-feature ROI union covered/preserved. Not a physical native point or canonical/selected-instance certificate.
existing_weak_contract.objective_evidence: source_target_contract.objective uses the same direct_end_external_logit for point32 and weak16, with base+point+0.25weak. A separate coefficient/authority tag does not itself establish semantic equivalence.

critical_findings.finding: A visible feature can be real but not identifiable as the question asked by the unconditioned q/native/RGB head. Same feature-kind and overlapping ROI do not establish intended-part/instance identity.
critical_findings.recommendation: Record whether original q/native plus same-frame context uniquely addresses this intended feature. If explicit ROI/feature-selector would additionally be needed, retain LOCAL_FEATURE_ONLY and do not copy its labels to the current native primary logit.
critical_findings.not_required: q inside ROI, exact3D point, perfect mesh, minimum ROI area

critical_findings.finding: Native-part visibility, local witness coverage, and query support are different targets.
critical_findings.recommendation: Keep factual native weak observation, controlled witness covered/preserved target, and per-variant query support as separate fields/authorities. Do not translate generic wood, center-owner, OFF query, missing part or nonmask into native E.

critical_findings.finding: Covering a witness need not change q support; preserving a witness need not preserve q support.

invented_display_only_example.interpretation: COVER can change only the remote witness; SHAM can cover q while leaving witness untouched. This is algebraic illustration, not new image/label evidence.

critical_findings.recommendation: A query-support label must be observed/proved for the actual variant; it cannot inherit the weak witness D/E name.

critical_findings.finding: Two readers may agree on a local part or even the same wrong instance. Agreement and ROI overlap are reproducibility evidence, not3D/native gold.
critical_findings.recommendation: Predeclare intended target-instance rule; have both independently inspect each same frame/row before joining. Preserve compatible descriptions, exact input/view bindings, UNKNOWN and disagreement. Never silently adjust one observer to consensus.

critical_findings.finding: A part visible elsewhere in fullimage can be absent from the original96 input. Availability85 is not semantic known85.
critical_findings.recommendation: For primary input supervision require local evidence in the actual original crop addressing the intended part; preserve all96 rows/U11. Fullimage may support identity/context but cannot make a missing crop witness visible. Original U stays unavailable and loss-unknown.

critical_findings.finding: SOURCE_FIT/DEV are internal development roles distinct from immutable outer TRAIN. Existing exposure is not erased.
critical_findings.recommendation: Freeze deterministic component assignments before annotations; root/A proposed2FIT+1DEV per prefix means8/4 frames. DEV must be excluded from every future loss branch and augmentation descendant, including old owner/support auxiliaries. Never turn excluded FIT/jitter into DEV by complement; no class/metric-driven split repair.

field_recommendations.limit: Coarse observed identity, not pose/3D certification. Multiple candidate objects or q8 spread across objects may remain UNKNOWN.
Requires a specific part of the selected instance; generic material/object presence is insufficient. No invented canonical mapping.
ROI is a weak visible feature region; not corrected q, point gold or full part mask.
No distance/q-containment gate. The annotator must explain which feature the existing inputs ask about. ROI-only ambiguity prevents native-primary admission.

Visual relation to identified intended part, not box-membership truth, GT reprojection error or corrected coordinate. Qualitative NEAR needs frozen operational wording; do not fit a distance threshold from scores.

E requires positive foreign foreground plus supported relation to intended part; another object/background/OFF alone is not E. SELF stays separate and may remain UNKNOWN when geometry cannot be inferred.

field_recommendations.rule: New assistant SOURCE semantic weak evidence only; no model scores/GT/other observer labels before sealing.

paired_control_recommendations: Before any new control, freeze all candidate rows/attempts and preserve unavailable/UNKNOWN/geometry failure; no crop, q/L/native/U change. Factual case counted once regardless donor multiplicity.

Retain the same transformed donor RGB and alpha pattern, alpha mass, original valid96 and originalq/native/context across COVER/SHAM; full opaque coverage of the exact union of independently recorded witness rectangles, zero SHAM alpha on that union. The union is neither bbox nor intersection.

Check actual bytes: alpha positive only on valid pixels, outside-alpha RGB unchanged, SHAM witness RGB unchanged, COVER produces real RGB change in each declared witness. If actual change fails, preserve failure rather than search a visually convenient replacement.

Record whether enough surrounding intended-part evidence remains to address the feature after intervention. This is a prospective observability/identity question, not a new perfect-mesh or fixed-area gate and not a claim the old V207 operator already certified it.

Keep source image/world physical occlusion separate from post-sampler2D augmentation. A covered local feature receives controlled-witness authority only until a separate native-part rule is prospectively admitted.
For query-support supervision, independently reassess each actual variant or use a separately frozen positive-support mask/proof; neither weak COVER nor weak SHAM name determines q support.

admission_boundaries.native_primary_candidate: Only future explicit root admission after same-frame independent agreement on selected instance, intended part and original-input addressability, local visibility/positive external evidence, original available input and correct SOURCE_FIT role. Weak authority remains explicit; no physicalgold certification demanded.
admission_boundaries.auxiliary_only: LOCAL_FEATURE_ONLY or EXPLICIT_ROI_SELECTOR_NEEDED is retained as observation. A future ROI-conditioned branch/spatial auxiliary loss may use it under a separate contract; current unconditioned native directlogit cannot receive the auxiliary label by copying.

same_frame_agreement: Root6+B6 in V215 covered12 complementary frames; it is not two-reader agreement on those same96 rows. New independent readers must both inspect every intended same-frame row.

Agree on instance/part and witness identity, not merely YES+same feature-kind. Preserve both ROI alternatives; compatible same-witness union can define a conservative control obligation without a minimum IoU/area or q-centering gold rule.
A disagreement remains UNKNOWN/not-admitted for the relevant task while all observations remain archived. It is not repaired by choosing the easier reader, moving q, or changing source selection.
